name: Crash Desk
author: Carlos Granier
description: A history of what crashed on this machine, grouped by program, with one-key AI diagnosis. The crash toast tells you once; Crash Desk remembers.

barWidget.description: Appears when something has crashed since you last looked. The panel groups crash loops by program and hands any of them to your default coding agent.

schema.label: Always show
schema.description: Keep the bar icon visible even when there is nothing new. Off, it only appears after a crash.

schema.label: Include other users
schema.description: Also list crashes of system daemons and other users, when you are allowed to read them.
